About ▲AAR

Built for the Next Phase of ARC

▲AAR is a community-driven token project built on the ARC network, created around a simple idea:

Launch together. Grow together. Evolve together.

The project begins with a focused token launch and community-building phase. As ▲AAR develops and reaches its defined graduation milestone, the ecosystem is planned to introduce automated reward and burn mechanics.

Rather than relying on complicated systems from day one, ▲AAR is designed to progressively introduce utility as the project grows.

💎 Reward System

Graduation Unlocks the Next Phase

The ▲AAR reward system is planned to activate after the token reaches its defined graduation milestone. The system is designed to make future rewards part of the project's on-chain ecosystem rather than relying entirely on manual distribution.

Community participation

Ecosystem activity

Eligible on-chain activity

Future community campaigns

Other publicly announced reward programs

Automated by Design

Once activated, the reward mechanism is intended to operate according to predefined smart-contract rules. Reward eligibility, amounts, frequency, and distribution conditions will be published before activation.

🔥 Burn Mechanics

Designed to Reduce Circulating Supply

Following graduation, ▲AAR plans to introduce a token burn mechanism. Tokens designated for burning will be permanently removed from circulation according to the project's defined rules.

How It Works

1. Graduation

▲AAR reaches the defined graduation milestone.

↓

2. Burn System Activation

The post-graduation burn mechanism becomes active.

↓

3. On-Chain Execution

Eligible burn transactions are executed according to the published rules.

↓

4. Permanent Removal

Burned tokens are permanently removed from circulation.

Full Transparency: Burn activity can be tracked through the relevant blockchain records once the mechanism is live.

🎓 Graduation

A Milestone, Not the Finish Line

Graduation represents the transition from the initial ▲AAR launch phase into the project's planned post-graduation ecosystem.

Before Graduation

Launch → Community → Growth

The primary focus is:

  • Establishing the ▲AAR community
  • Building awareness
  • Growing participation
  • Developing the ecosystem
  • Preparing post-graduation infrastructure

After Graduation

Rewards → Burn → Ecosystem

The project plans to activate:

  • Automated rewards
  • Burn mechanics
  • Additional token utility
  • Future ecosystem features

Graduation is where the next chapter begins.

❓ FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is ▲AAR?

▲AAR is a community-driven token project built on the ARC network.

What is the total supply?

The planned total supply is 1,000,000,000 ▲AAR.

Is ▲AAR an NFT?

No. ▲AAR is a token project.

What happens at graduation?

Graduation marks the transition into the project's planned post-graduation phase, where the automated reward system and burn mechanics are intended to become active.

Are rewards active immediately?

No. The reward system is planned as a post-graduation feature.

When will the burn mechanism activate?

The burn mechanism is planned to activate after the defined graduation milestone, subject to the final smart-contract implementation.

How will rewards work?

The exact eligibility requirements, distribution method, frequency, and parameters will be published before the reward system is activated.

Can burned tokens be recovered?

Tokens permanently burned through the blockchain mechanism are intended to be irreversibly removed from circulation.

Where can I get official updates?

Only rely on the official ▲AAR website and verified community channels for project announcements.
